title: Product, UX & Generative UI
rules: First-run experience must reach value in under 60 seconds.
Every screen needs an empty state, a loading state and an error state.
Prefer generative UI (json-render style) for data-shaped screens: same schema, many layouts.
One primary action per screen; destructive actions require explicit confirmation.
Form fields must be justified one by one; each optional field is friction debt.
Keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels ship with the feature, not after it.
checklist: Is there a visible path back (undo, breadcrumb, cancel)?
Does the empty state teach the first action?
Are interactive elements at least 44px touch targets on mobile?
Is the copy specific (no 'something went wrong' alone)?
Are component props typed and documented for reuse?

scoringRubric.1-3: Confusing: no states, unclear actions, blocked flows.
scoringRubric.4-6: Usable but rough: missing states, unmeasured activation, inconsistent copy.
scoringRubric.7-8: Clean: all states covered, fast first value, typed components, accessible.
scoringRubric.9-10: Delightful: generative layouts, personalized onboarding, measurable retention lift.
